detector_config.downbeats: heuristic beat_times[::4], with [::3] retained as a candidate. DBNDownBeatTrackingProcessor is not called.

metric_contract.aggregates: Macro is the unweighted mean of per-recording scores. Duration-weighted chord scores sum time. Micro beat scores pool counts. Styles are aggregated the same way.
metric_contract.bare_triad_recall: Among reference time whose shorthand is exactly maj or min, the prediction shorthand is that same triad. min7 does not count as min. This is not a major/minor swap rate.
metric_contract.beats: 70 ms one-to-one. The BACKEND-04I greedy matcher is always reported. When either series has a gap at or under 140 ms, the official count is a deterministic maximum-cardinality matching.
metric_contract.boundary: Pair a reference segment only when a prediction shares its root pitch class and covers at least half of it. Unmatched segments stay out of the mean and are counted.
metric_contract.enharmonic_shorthand: Same root pitch class, shorthand, and bass. Spelling may differ. Extensions stay unmatched.
metric_contract.exact: Raw Harte string equality. No enharmonic rewrite and no seventh folding.
metric_contract.ground_truth: Lead-sheet JAMS layer for chords. beat_position for beats. Tempo annotation for BPM error. Labels are not supplied to the models.
metric_contract.half_diminished_confusion: Reference shorthand is hdim7 and the prediction is not the same shorthand and bass on the same root pitch class. Enharmonic hdim7 is not confusion.
metric_contract.no_chord_false_positive: Reference is a chord and the prediction is N.
metric_contract.root: Root pitch class. Enharmonic spellings match. N matches neither a chord root.
metric_contract.same_root_major_minor_swap: Both shorthands are bare triads, the root pitch class matches, and the qualities differ.
metric_contract.seventh_versus_triad: Same root pitch class, reference shorthand is a bare triad, and prediction shorthand is 7, maj7, or min7. Reported separately and not added to the exact score.

pre_registration: Written before model inference. Selection and metric text are fixed here.
runtime_pin_note: Python, torch, and madmom versions are recorded at seal time and checked again at run time.
